scripts.text:
============ Notice ============
We would like to inform that the Hunter Job Change Location
has been moved to ^ff0000Hugel^000000 in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
============ 告示 ============
獵人轉職地點已遷至修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的^ff0000毀葛^000000。

scripts.text: You can now use the Hugel airline, so please use the airship to visit Hugel.
scripts.translation: 現在可以使用毀葛航線了，請乘坐飛空艇前往毀葛。

scripts.text: You will find the new Job Change Location at ^ff0000 Hugel 208 222 ^000000.

^804000(You found a tiny line written at the end of the notice.)^000000
 
 
 
I, the Falcon breeder have moved out as well.
scripts.translation:
^804000(你在告示末尾發現了一行小字。)^000000
 
 
 
我，獵鷹飼養員，也搬走了。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Oh, how have you been? It's been a long time, hasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
哦，最近過得怎麼樣？
好久不見了吧？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
...Wait.
Oops! I'm sorry, I could have sworn that we've met before. Huh. How weird.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
...等等。
哎呀，抱歉！我還以為我們以前見過呢。
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Eh? You haven't had enough training as an Archer yet. To become a Hunter, you must gain a certain level of experience as an Archer first.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
咦？你作為弓箭手，修行還不夠。
想成為獵人，得先積累足夠的弓箭手經驗。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Go out and train yourself a bit more. You'll need to be at least Job Level 40 before you'll be ready to become a Hunter. Of course, you can train more than that if you want.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
再去多練練吧。
職業等級至少達到40級，才能轉職為獵人。
當然，你願意的話，也可以練到更高的等級。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
See you next time~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
下次見~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
You can't change jobs without using all your skill points. Please use all of your skill points before applying to change jobs~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
技能點沒用完，是不能轉職的。
申請轉職前，請先用完所有技能點~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
You must be...
a Novice? Wow, you've got a long way ahead of you. I don't think there's much you can do here.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
你是...初心者吧？
哇，你還有很長的路要走呢。
這裡恐怕暫時幫不上你什麼忙。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
You have chosen the path of the sword. I can respect the strength of your blade. Of course, from far away, you can't really afford to throw your sword at enemies, can you?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
你選擇了用劍的道路，我也認可劍的威力。
不過，敵人離得遠的時候，總不能把劍扔過去吧？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
You deal with magic? It must feel great to be able to wield mystic power.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
你使用魔法？能駕馭神秘力量一定很棒吧。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Oh, a person who serves God! Nice to meet you. There aren't many people like you that visit this place~ Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
哦，是侍奉上帝的人！
很高興見到你。
像你這樣的人，很少來這裡呢~呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Oh...
How's your business coming along?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
哦...
生意做得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Agh?!
This place doesn't have anything worth stealing or anyone worth killing!!
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
啊？！
這裡沒有什麼值得偷的東西，也沒有值得殺的人！！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Phew...sometimes it is really hard for being a hunter, you know...
So how do you like your bohemian life? Yeah, I am envious of you for having so much freedom...
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
呼...當獵人有時也挺辛苦的，你知道吧...
你那無拘無束的生活過得怎麼樣？
真羨慕你能那麼自由...

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Oh~ {0}!!
Long time no see~ What brings you here? Did your Falcon run away or something?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
哦~{0}！！
好久不見~什麼風把你吹來了？
該不會是獵鷹跑了吧？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
I don't really have any official notices from the guild at the moment, so I hope you didn't come here just for that...
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
我目前並沒有收到公會的正式通知，希望你不是專門為了這個才來的...

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Hmm... I've been informed that you passed the test. But you don't have the necessary 'Necklace of Wisdom (Penetration)' that proves your accomplishment.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
嗯...我聽說你通過了測試。
但你沒有帶來證明合格的“慧眼（穿透）”。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
I'll let you change your job, but you must bring back a 'Necklace of Wisdom (Penetration),' no matter what it takes.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
我可以讓你轉職，但無論如何，你都必須帶回“慧眼（穿透）”。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Oh...?
You passed
the job test?!
Congratulations~!!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
哦...？
你通過轉職測試了？！
恭喜~！！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Well then,
I will now change
your job to a Hunter~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
那麼，現在就讓你轉職為獵人~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Tada~ Congratulations!
You look great as a Hunter!!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
鏘鏘~恭喜！
你這身獵人的裝束真不錯！！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Become a noble person and become a worthy representative of our Hunter Guild. Show your love of nature as a Hunter~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
要做個品格高尚的人，成為無愧於獵人公會的代表。
用獵人的行動，展現你對自然的熱愛吧~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
And also, here is a little reward for all the effort you put in. It's from me, of course~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
還有，這是給你的小小獎勵，感謝你付出的努力。
當然，是我個人送的~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Oh, you're an Archer! It seems as if you've trained enough as an Archer... You came here to become a Hunter, right?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
哦，你是弓箭手！
看來已經修行得差不多了...
你是來轉職為獵人的吧？

scripts.text: Yes. That's what I'm here for.
scripts.translation: 是的，我就是為此而來

scripts.text: What are the requirements to change jobs?
scripts.translation: 轉職有什麼要求？

scripts.text: ....I don't want to change yet.
scripts.translation: ...我暫時不想轉職

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Hehe~
I was right! Let me put you on the candidate list. Let's see~*
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
嘿嘿~我猜對了！
讓我把你登記到候選名單上。
看看~*

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Hmm... Let's start with the interview. Wait and relax a moment. No need to worry, I'll prepare everything~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
嗯...先從面試開始吧。
稍等一下，放輕鬆。
別擔心，我會準備好一切的~

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Gathers and flips through papers*^000000
^3355FF*Rummage rummage*^000000

[Hunter Guildsman]
Ah!
Here they are: the interview questions~ First of all, my name is 'Sherin.' Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
啊！找到了，面試題目~
先自我介紹一下，我叫謝琳。
很高興見到你！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Well then,
shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
那麼，我們開始吧？

scripts.text: Yes~ Let's start now.
scripts.translation: 好~現在就開始

scripts.text: No, I'll be back later.
scripts.translation: 不，我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Okay...
Come back
when you're ready~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
好的...準備好了再回來~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Listen carefully to the scenarios I describe. When I ask a question, you choose an answer. Pretty simple, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
仔細聽我描述的情境，等我提問時選一個答案。
很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
I just want to know how you think about life, and why you want to become a Hunter, so there's no need to be nervous.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
我只是想了解你對生活的看法，以及想成為獵人的理由，不用緊張。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Job change
requirements?
First...
You must be an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
轉職條件？
首先...你必須是弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Second...
You must be
at least Job Level 40.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
其次...職業等級至少要達到40級。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Third...
You must bring all of the items that will be requested by the guild. You can worry about that later.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
第三...帶齊公會要求的物品。
這件事可以之後再考慮。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Fourth...
You've gotta pass the test administered by the guild. If you have had enough training as an Archer, you should be able to pass the test~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
第四...通過公會的測試。
只要你作為弓箭手的修行足夠，應該就能通過~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Okay then,
see you next time~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
那就下次見~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Welcome back...!
Well, let's start with the interview. This time, carefully think about the answers to each question.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
歡迎回來...！
好，開始面試吧。
這次要仔細思考每一道題的答案哦。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Well then,
let's begin.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
那麼，開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
You are an Archer, and you don't know where you should go to hunt. What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
你是一名弓箭手，卻不知道該去哪裡狩獵。你會怎麼做？

scripts.text: Scream out loud asking where you should go.
scripts.translation: 大聲喊著問該去哪裡

scripts.text: Quietly ask a person passing by.
scripts.translation: 輕聲詢問路人

scripts.text: Wander around alone and search for a place.
scripts.translation: 獨自四處尋找

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
So you've decided on a place to hunt. You're going to hunt the monsters known as Hodes in the Sograt Desert.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
你選好了狩獵地點，打算去蘇克拉特沙漠獵殺蚯蚓。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
But you are in Payon!!
How do you go to the desert?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
但你現在人在斐揚！！
你要怎麼去沙漠？

scripts.text: Ask a Priest to open a free warp portal.
scripts.translation: 請牧師免費開啟傳送之陣

scripts.text: Use the Kafra service.
scripts.translation: 使用卡普拉服務

scripts.text: Walk with a friend.
scripts.translation: 和朋友一起走過去

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
There is no Priest to ask for a warp, and no friend is around to walk with you. You must use the Kafra service, but you have no Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
你找不到能幫忙傳送的牧師，也沒有朋友能陪你走過去。
只能使用卡普拉服務，可你沒有Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
How would you go
about to make the
Zeny that you need?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
你會怎麼賺夠所需的Zeny？

scripts.text: Beg here and there.
scripts.translation: 到處乞討

scripts.text: Sell items I do not need.
scripts.translation: 出售不需要的物品

scripts.text: Hunt at a nearby field.
scripts.translation: 在附近的野外狩獵

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
So you finally arrive at the Sograt Desert. But you realize that Hodes are a bit too strong for you to hunt alone.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
你終於來到蘇克拉特沙漠，卻發現蚯蚓太強，一個人不太好對付。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
What is your
solution to this
situation?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
遇到這種情況，你會怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Attack a Hode from the top of a hill.
scripts.translation: 從山頂攻擊蚯蚓

scripts.text: Go back to town.
scripts.translation: 返回城鎮

scripts.text: Attack someone else's Hode.
scripts.translation: 攻擊別人正在打的蚯蚓

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Let's say you were having too much trouble hunting Hodes and returned to town. Now you are out of HP and a Priest happens to be around. How would you ask for a Heal?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
假設你覺得蚯蚓太難打，便回到了城鎮。
現在你的HP耗盡，正好附近有位牧師。
你會怎麼請對方施放治癒術？

scripts.text: Would it be possible to get a Heal, please?
scripts.translation: 請問可以為我施放治癒術嗎？

scripts.text: Heal, please.
scripts.translation: 請幫我治癒一下

scripts.text: Heal me.
scripts.translation: 給我治癒

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
This time, you found a rare item while you were going through your inventory. You go out to sell the item, and there are many people with stores and chatrooms open.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
這次，你整理物品欄時發現了一件稀有物品。
你想把它賣掉，出去後看到許多人在擺攤、開聊天室。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
What is the
best way to
sell your item?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
怎樣才能最好地賣出這件物品？

scripts.text: Scream out loud to everyone in sight.
scripts.translation: 大聲向周圍所有人喊話

scripts.text: Open a chatroom and wait.
scripts.translation: 開聊天室等待

scripts.text: Look to see if anyone already wants it.
scripts.translation: 看看有沒有人在收購

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
While you are waiting, someone is begging for items and Zeny. What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
在等待期間，有人正在乞討物品和Zeny。你應該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Give some of my items and Zeny.
scripts.translation: 給他一些物品和Zeny

scripts.text: Ignore and walk away.
scripts.translation: 無視並走開

scripts.text: Tell the person about a good place to hunt.
scripts.translation: 告訴對方一個適合狩獵的地方

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
By now, you decide to go to the Maze by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
現在，你決定獨自前往迷宮。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
But on your way, you run
into someone that is lost.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
但在途中，你遇到了一個迷路的人。
你應該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Tell them which way to go.
scripts.translation: 告訴對方該往哪走

scripts.text: Guide them to their destination.
scripts.translation: 帶對方去目的地

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
After meeting this lost person, you decide to get back to hunting. Just then, you find that someone is attacking a boss!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
遇到那個迷路的人後，你決定繼續狩獵。
這時，你發現有人正在打首領！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
你應該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Watch, then attack when asked for help.
scripts.translation: 先觀望，等對方求助再出手

scripts.text: Attack and see what happens.
scripts.translation: 直接攻擊，看看會怎樣

scripts.text: Just go back to town.
scripts.translation: 直接回城

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
You are now very exhausted after your day of hunting. It's time to go back to town.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
狩獵了一整天，你已經很累，該回城了。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
But what's this!? You find an expensive item lying on the floor! What should you do with it?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
咦，這是什麼！？
你發現地上有件貴重物品！
你會怎麼處理？

scripts.text: Pick it up and keep it.
scripts.translation: 撿起來據為己有

scripts.text: Try to find the owner.
scripts.translation: 試著尋找失主

scripts.text: Just walk by.
scripts.translation: 直接走過去

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Okay, this is the end of the test!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
好了，測試到此結束！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Well done! Your answers show you've got the right outlook on life. You definitely have the right qualities to become a Hunter~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
答得很好！
你的回答表明你有正確的人生觀。
你確實具備成為獵人的素質~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
I'm glad to say you've passed the interview~ Now, go to that person in the corner and confirm which item is necessary for your job change test~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
很高興告訴你，面試通過了~
去找角落裡那個人，確認轉職測試需要哪些物品吧~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Well, I'm looking at your answers and your score isn't perfect. But I'll let you pass anyway. I don't know what our Guildmaster will think, though.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
嗯，看了你的回答，成績還不算完美。
不過，還是讓你通過吧。
只是不知道會長會怎麼想。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Just remember to always keep basic etiquette in mind. Try harder in the following tests and make me happy, okay?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
記得時刻遵守基本禮儀。
接下來的測試要更努力些，別讓我失望哦？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Hmm... I don't think this'll work out. You can't become a Hunter without knowing basic etiquette.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
嗯...這樣可不行。
不懂基本禮儀，是不能成為獵人的。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Think about how you answered the questions one more time. In order to value nature, you must first value your relationship with others.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
再好好想想你是怎麼回答那些問題的吧。想要珍視自然，首先得珍視你與他人的關係。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Then, you'll be more in tune with nature and with other people. It's this kind of harmony that makes the best Hunters.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
這樣，你才能與自然、與他人和諧相處。
最優秀的獵人，正是懂得這種和諧的人。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Just give the item to the Demon Hunter, the guy who's all the way to the left in this area~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
只要把物品交給惡魔獵人就好，就是這片區域最左邊的那個人~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
If you decide to become a Hunter, promise to come visit me. I want to see you as a Hunter. You would look great!!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
決定成為獵人的話，要答應我回來看看哦。
我想看看你成為獵人的樣子，一定很帥！！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
If you decide to become a Hunter, come and visit me, okay? You're pretty, but... You'd be even prettier as a Hunter. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
決定成為獵人的話，要回來看看哦？
你已經很漂亮了，不過...穿上獵人的裝束，會更漂亮。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
????
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
????

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
You weren't able to find the Demon Hunter? That guy is just to the left! Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
你居然沒找到惡魔獵人？那個人就在左邊！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
I want to see you become a Hunter...! Waaah~ I think you'd look great, so please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
我想看你成為獵人的樣子...！
哇~一定很帥，快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
Hmm, I think you're supposed to visit someone else, not me. Like our Guildmaster who's out for business, you know?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
嗯，你現在該找的不是我，而是別人。
比如我們那位出差的會長。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Sherin]
I heard he's at the Payon Central Palace... Or in the Archer Village, one of those two places. Try visiting those places and find him, okay?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 謝琳]
聽說他在斐揚中央宮殿...或者弓箭手村，兩處之一。
去那裡找找他吧？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Eh? You haven't trained enough as an Archer. To become a Hunter, you need to gain more experience as an Archer first.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
咦？你作為弓箭手，修行還不夠。
想成為獵人，得先積累更多弓箭手經驗。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildsman]
Well then, go train some more. You must be at least Job Level 40 to be exact. Of course, you can always go higher. See you next time~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會成員]
再去多練練吧。
準確地說，職業等級至少要達到40級。
當然，也可以練到更高。
下次見~

scripts.text:
[Guild Receptionist]
Greetings. They call me... ^660000The Demon Hunter^000000. I am the one in charge of processing applications. Your name is ... {0}, correct?
scripts.translation:
[公會接待員]
你好，大家稱我為...^660000惡魔獵人^000000。
我負責受理申請。
你的名字是...{0}，對吧？

scripts.text: Yes, that is correct.
scripts.translation: 是的，沒錯

scripts.text: Nope~~(heeheehee)
scripts.translation: 才不是呢~~（嘿嘿嘿）

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
Hey, stop messing around.
Your name is {0}, right?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
嘿，別開玩笑了。
你的名字是{0}，對吧？

scripts.text: Yes...
scripts.translation: 是的...

scripts.text: Hehehe. I keep telling you, it's not~~
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，都說了不是我~~

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
Leave if you plan to trifle me your petty tricks. Do you not realize that you are toying with ^660000The Demon Hunter^000000?!'
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
想用那些小把戲耍我，就給我走人。
你不知道自己在戲弄^660000惡魔獵人^000000嗎？！'

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
Okay. These are the items you need for the test. Since we provide all the arrows you will be using for this test, we need you to get the materials to make them.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
好，測試需要這些物品。
測試用的箭矢由我們提供，所以需要你收集制箭的材料。

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
You see, we're having some financial problems. Let's see, we're short on these items...
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
你也知道，我們最近手頭有點緊。
看看，還缺這些東西...

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
Hmm. ^660000{0} {1}^000000 to use for arrow tips. ^660000{2} {3}^000000 to use here and there. And ^660000{4} {5}^000000 please.

[Demon Hunter]
By the way, a member of our Hunter Guild is at the Archer Guild on official business. I believe you have to go visit this person since he is in charge of the testing.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
順便說一下，獵人公會有位成員正在弓箭手公會辦事。
他負責測試，你得去找他。

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
Oh right. Our Guildmaster has gone on an official trip to the Payon Central Palace. You have to go visit him because the one that administers the test.
You can find him in a building east of the Payon Central Palace.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
哦，對了，會長去斐揚中央宮殿辦事了。
他負責測試，你得去找他。
他就在斐揚中央宮殿東側的一棟建築裡。

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
Alright then, come back to me when you have everything ready~
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
那麼，等你準備好所有東西后再回來找我吧~

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
You brought all of the necessary materials... You can get directions to the testing area from our Guildmaster who is currently in the Payon Central Palace.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
所需的材料都帶齊了...
會長現在在斐揚中央宮殿，去問他怎麼到測試場地吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
You brought all of the necessary materials... To get directions to the testing area, go talk to our Guildmaster who is at the Archer Guild.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
所需的材料都帶齊了...
去弓箭手公會找會長，問他怎麼到測試場地吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
You don't have all
of the required materials...
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
你還沒有集齊所有必需的材料...

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
The items you need are
^660000{0} {1}^000000,
^660000{2} {3}^000000 and
^660000{4} {5}^000000.
Come back once you have
gathered all the items.

[Demon Hunter]
Hmm? You didn't go to the Guildmaster either in Payon Central Palace or at the Archer Guild? He should be at one of the two places, so go look for him.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
嗯？還沒去斐揚中央宮殿或弓箭手公會找會長？
他應該在這兩處之一，去找找吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon Hunter]
Ooh. You passed the test. Congratulations~ You should go talk to Sherin now.
scripts.translation:
[惡魔獵人]
哦，通過測試了。
恭喜~現在去找謝琳吧。

scripts.text:
[Guild Receptionist]
If you wish to change your job to a Hunter, you must register first.
scripts.translation:
[公會接待員]
想轉職為獵人，得先登記。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Hmpf. You must be here for the Hunter job test. Let me tell you about the testing process. What would you like to know?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
哼，你是來參加獵人轉職測試的吧。
我來說明測試流程，你想了解什麼？

scripts.text: What is the test?
scripts.translation: 測試內容是什麼？

scripts.text: What are the passing requirements?
scripts.translation: 通過標準是什麼？

scripts.text: Any warnings?
scripts.translation: 有什麼注意事項？

scripts.text: Begin test.
scripts.translation: 開始測試

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
You have to hunt down certain monsters with a particular name. But you must avoid all the traps while you're at it.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
你要獵殺指定名稱的魔物，同時避開所有陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
This is to test your ability to move swiftly and locate targets in various situations.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
這項測試考驗你在各種情況下迅速移動、找到目標的能力。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Within the time limit, starting in the 6 o'clock direction of the map, you must hunt the target monsters and then hit the escape switch that will appear in the center of the map.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
在限定時間內，從地圖的6點鐘方向開始，獵殺目標魔物，然後按下地圖中央出現的逃脫開關。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
You will pass if you are able to escape in the 12 o'clock direction of the map after you hit the switch.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
按下開關後，從地圖12點鐘方向逃出去，就算通過。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Hmm. Warnings... Well, if you fall into a trap, you have to start from the beginning. Also, only one person can take the test at a time.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯，注意事項...
一旦落入陷阱，就得從頭再來。
另外，一次只能有一個人參加測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
I will send you to the testing place. There will be a waiting room, but if someone else is taking the test, you must wait in the chatroom.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
我會把你送到測試場地，那裡有候場室。
如果有人正在測試，你必須在聊天室裡等待。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
If the person in front succeeds, resigns or fails, the next person waiting in the chatroom is sent to the testing area. If nobody is waiting, the test will begin as soon as you enter the chatroom.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
前一個人通過、放棄或失敗後，聊天室裡的下一位就會被送進考場。
如果沒人排隊，你進入聊天室後就會立即開始測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Okay. I'll send you to the testing area right now. Don't blame me if you get lost or confused because you didn't listen to my explanation.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
好，現在就送你去考場。
要是沒聽我的說明，到時迷路或不知所措，可別怪我。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Well, then. Your arrows are probably still being made, so you can use mine to take the test.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
你的箭矢大概還沒做好，測試時就先用我的吧。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Mmm...?
What is an Archer
visiting me for?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯...？弓箭手找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
I wasn't notified about anything in particular from the Hunter Guild. You're not trying to skip the middle part of the Hunter test, are you?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
獵人公會沒通知我有什麼特別的事。
你該不會想跳過獵人測試的中間環節吧？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Go gather the items for the test, and come back after you've visited the Hunter Guild.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
去收集測試所需的物品，然後去獵人公會報到後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Hunter]
Hmm? Can I help you? If you wish to change jobs, you should visit the person at the Archer Guild, not me.
scripts.translation:
[獵人]
嗯？有什麼事嗎？如果你想轉職，應該去弓箭手公會找負責的人，而不是我。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Hmm. You're the Archer that almost gave up on changing jobs. You do have everything ready, right? Then I'll send you to take the test right away.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯，你就是那個差點放棄轉職的弓箭手。
這次都準備好了吧？
那我馬上送你去參加測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
If you have any
questions, ask now.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
有問題就趁現在問。

scripts.text: What is the test?
scripts.translation: 測試內容是什麼？

scripts.text: What are the passing requirements?
scripts.translation: 通過標準是什麼？

scripts.text: Any warnings?
scripts.translation: 有什麼注意事項？

scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
你要獵殺指定名稱的魔物，同時避開所有陷阱。
這項測試考驗你在各種情況下迅速移動、找到目標的能力。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Within the given time, you will start at the 6 o'clock direction of the map, hunt the target monsters, and then hit the escape switch that will appear in the center of the map.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
在限定時間內，從地圖的6點鐘方向開始，獵殺目標魔物，然後按下地圖中央出現的逃脫開關。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
You will pass if you are able to escape in the 12 o'clock direction of the map after you hit the switch.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
按下開關後，從地圖12點鐘方向逃出去，就算通過。

scripts.text:

Hmm. Warnings... Well, if you fall into a trap, you have to start from the beginning. Also, only one person can take the test at a time.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯，注意事項...
一旦落入陷阱，就得從頭再來。
另外，一次只能有一個人參加測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
I'll send you to the testing place. There is a waiting room, but if someone else is taking the test, you must wait in the chatroom.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
我會把你送到測試場地，那裡有候場室。
如果有人正在測試，你必須在聊天室裡等待。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
If the person in front succeeds, resigns or fails, the next person waiting in the chatroom is sent to the testing area. If nobody is waiting, the test will begin as soon as you enter the chatroom.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
前一個人通過、放棄或失敗後，聊天室裡的下一位就會被送進考場。
如果沒人排隊，你進入聊天室後就會立即開始測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Okay. Good luck.
I'll send you right now.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
好，祝你好運。
現在就送你過去。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Eh? Why won't I give you Silver Arrows? Don't expect anything when you don't bring any materials.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
咦？問我為什麼不給你銀箭矢？
沒帶材料，就別指望我給你什麼。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Anyway, I believe you've prepared it yourself. Let's begin now.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
總之，我相信你已經自己準備好了。
開始吧。

scripts.text: Okay. Let's start...
scripts.translation: 好，開始吧...

scripts.text: Ah, wait a sec.
scripts.translation: 啊，等一下

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Okay!! I hope
you will pass this time!
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
好！！希望這次你能通過！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Then hurry and finish
all of your preparations.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
那就趕緊把準備工作做好。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Wow, you came back in one piece!
I mean, good job. I'll give you the item which proves that you have passed the test.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
哇，你竟然完好無損地回來了！
我是說，幹得好。
給你一件物品，證明你通過了測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Okay, here it is. Now, go back to the Hunter Guild. I have some more business left to do here, but I hope you can become a Hunter soon.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
好，拿著。
回獵人公會去吧。
我在這裡還有些事要辦，希望你能早日成為獵人。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
I see you aren't in a hurry to become a Hunter? When I first became a Hunter, I ran around for a month wildly brandishing my bow because I was so happy. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
看來你不急著成為獵人？
我剛轉職那會兒，高興得揮著弓到處亂跑，足足跑了一個月。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Now, you should go back to the Hunter Guild~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
現在，你應該回到獵人公會了~

scripts.text:
[Hunter]
...Can I help you?
I'm here for official business and am busy at the moment. If you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[獵人]
...有什麼事嗎？
我在這裡辦公務，現在正忙，請見諒...

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Mmm. I see you're here for the Hunter job test. Let me explain the testing process. What would you like to know?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯，看來你是來參加獵人轉職測試的。
我來說明測試流程，你想了解什麼？

scripts.text:

你要獵殺指定名稱的魔物，同時避開這裡的所有陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
This is to test your ability to move swiftly and locate targets in various situations.

這項測試考驗你在各種情況下迅速移動、找到目標的能力。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Within the given time, you will start in the 6 o'clock direction of the map, hunt the target monsters, and hit the escape switch that will appear in the center of the map.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
你將從地圖6點鐘方向出發，必須在規定時間內獵殺目標魔物，再按下地圖中央出現的逃脫開關。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
You will pass if you are able to escape in the 12 o'clock direction of the map when the switch is activated.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
開關啟動後，從地圖12點鐘方向逃出去，就算通過。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Mmm. Warnings... Well, if you fall into a trap, you have to start the test over from the beginning. And only one person can take the test at a time.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯，注意事項...
一旦落入陷阱，就得從頭再來。
而且，一次只能有一個人參加測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
I'll send you to the testing place. There is a waiting room, but if someone else is taking the test, you must wait in the chatroom.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
我會把你送到測試場地，那裡有候場室。
如果有人正在測試，你必須在聊天室裡等待。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
If the person currently taking the test passes or fails, the next person waiting in the chatroom is sent to the testing area. If nobody is waiting, the test will begin as soon as you enter the chatroom.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
正在測試的人通過或失敗後，聊天室裡的下一位就會被送進考場。
如果沒人排隊，你進入聊天室後就會立即開始測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
...Okay. I'll send you to the testing area right now. Don't blame me if you get lost or confused because you didn't listen to the explanation.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
...好，現在就送你去考場。
要是沒聽說明，到時迷路或不知所措，可別怪我。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Well, your arrows are probably still being made, so you can use mine to take the test.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
你的箭矢大概還沒做好，測試時就先用我的吧。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Mmm...?
Why is an Archer
visiting me?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯...？弓箭手來找我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
I wasn't notified by the Hunter Guild about anything. You're not trying to skip the middle part of the Hunter test, are you?
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
獵人公會沒通知我什麼事。
你該不會想跳過獵人測試的中間環節吧？

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Stop by once you have gathered all the items needed for the test.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
等你收集齊測試所需的所有物品後，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Hunter]
Mmm?
Can I help you
with something?
Oh, you must be
a Hunter applicant.
scripts.translation:
[獵人]
嗯？有什麼事嗎？
哦，你是來申請成為獵人的吧。

scripts.text:
[Hunter]
If you wish to change jobs, I think you need to go visit the person at Payon Central Palace.
scripts.translation:
[獵人]
想轉職的話，應該去斐揚中央宮殿找負責的人。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Mmm? Aren't you the Archer who gave up last time? Now you're ready, right? Then I'll send you to the job change area right now.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯？你不是上次放棄的弓箭手嗎？
這次準備好了吧？
那我現在就送你去轉職場地。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
If you still
have questions,
feel free to ask.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
還有什麼疑問，儘管問。

scripts.text: What is the test?
scripts.translation: 測試內容是什麼？

scripts.text: What are the requirements to pass the test?
scripts.translation: 通過測試的要求是什麼？

scripts.text: Any warnings?
scripts.translation: 有什麼注意事項？

scripts.text: Begin test.
scripts.translation: 開始測試

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
You have to hunt down certain monsters with a particular name, but you must avoid all of the traps here at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
你要獵殺指定名稱的魔物，同時避開這裡的所有陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
This is to test your ability to move swiftly and locate targets in various situations.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
這項測試考驗你在各種情況下迅速移動、找到目標的能力。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Within the given time, you will start in the 6 o'clock direction of the map, hunt the target monsters, and hit the escape switch that will appear in the center of the map.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
你將從地圖6點鐘方向出發，必須在規定時間內獵殺目標魔物，再按下地圖中央出現的逃脫開關。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
You will pass if you are able to escape in the 12 o'clock direction of the map when the switch is activated.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
開關啟動後，從地圖12點鐘方向逃出去，就算通過。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Mmm. Warnings... Well, if you fall into a trap, you have to start the test over from the beginning. And only one person can take the test at a time.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯，注意事項...
一旦落入陷阱，就得從頭再來。
而且，一次只能有一個人參加測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
I'll send you to the testing place. There is a waiting room, but if someone else is taking the test, you must wait in the chatroom.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
我會把你送到測試場地，那裡有候場室。
如果有人正在測試，你必須在聊天室裡等待。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
If the person currently taking the test passes or fails, the next person waiting in the chatroom is sent to the testing area. If nobody is waiting, the test will begin as soon as you enter the chatroom.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
正在測試的人通過或失敗後，聊天室裡的下一位就會被送進考場。
如果沒人排隊，你進入聊天室後就會立即開始測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Okay, good luck.
I'll send you right now...
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
好的，祝你好運。
我現在就送你過去...

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Eh? Why don't I give you any Silver Arrows? Well, you shouldn't expect to get anything when you didn't even bring the materials.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
咦？問我為什麼不給你銀箭矢？
連材料都沒帶，就別指望我給你什麼。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Well...
I believe
you're ready.
Let's begin.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯...我相信你已經準備好了。
開始吧。

scripts.text: Yes, let's start.
scripts.translation: 好，開始吧

scripts.text: Ah, wait a moment.
scripts.translation: 啊，等一下

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Okay!! Now...
Pass this time!
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
好！！那麼...
這次一定要通過！

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
*Sigh...*
Come back when
you're done with
your preparations.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
*嘆氣...*
準備好了再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Wow. You're back in one piece!
I mean, good job. Well then, I'll give you the item which serves as proof that you passed the test.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
哇，你竟然完好無損地回來了！
我是說，幹得好。
給你一件物品，證明你通過了測試。

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Well...
There you go.
Now hurry back to the Hunter Guild, and join us~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
嗯...拿著。
快回獵人公會，加入我們吧~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
I see you're not in a hurry to become a Hunter. I was running around with joy, wildly brandishing my bow the first month I became a Hunter. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
看來你不急著成為獵人。
我剛轉職的第一個月，高興得揮著弓到處亂跑。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Hunter Guildmaster]
Now hurry~
They're waiting
for you back
at the Hunter Guild.
scripts.translation:
[獵人公會會長]
快去吧~獵人公會的人正等著你呢。

scripts.text:
[Hunter]
What do you want? I'm on an official trip and am busy at the moment. Now if you'll excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[獵人]
你想幹什麼？我正在出差，現在很忙。失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Good day. Welcome to the Hunter testing site. The test begins when you enter the next room.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你好，歡迎來到獵人測試場地。
進入下一個房間，測試就會開始。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
As explained before, hunt 4 or more of the monsters named ^3355FFJob change monster^000000. Upon doing so, a switch in the center of the map will then appear.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
正如之前的說明，你要獵殺至少4只名為^3355FF轉職魔物^000000的魔物。
完成後，地圖中央會出現一個開關。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
When you destroy the switch, the exit will appear in the 12 o'clock direction of the map. Complete everything within the given time and escape.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
破壞開關後，出口會出現在地圖12點鐘方向。
請在規定時間內完成全部任務並逃出去。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If you faint in the middle, fall into a trap, or go over the time limit, you'll fail. Then you must then retake the test.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
如果中途倒下、落入陷阱或超時，就算失敗，必須重新測試。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
We will provide the arrows, so just make sure that you bring a bow. Well, then. Please enter when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
我們會提供箭矢，你只需帶好弓。
準備好了就進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Hmm...
Did you mess up?
I'll recover some
of your HP and SP for now.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
嗯...失敗了？
我先幫你恢復一些HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If it's too hard, it wouldn't hurt to try again next time. Would you like to resign for now?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
覺得太難的話，下次再試也無妨。
要先放棄嗎？

scripts.text: Keep trying.
scripts.translation: 繼續嘗試

scripts.text: Resign.
scripts.translation: 放棄

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Okay. Do your best and become a great Hunter. Please enter the waiting room. If someone is already taking the test, you must wait until that person is done.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
好，加油，爭取成為一名優秀的獵人。
請進入候場室。
如果有人正在測試，必須等對方結束。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Very well. I'll send you to Payon. Hope to see you next time. Don't forget to save when you leave.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
好，我送你回斐揚。
希望下次還能見到你。
離開時別忘了存檔。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You shouldn't be here. How about finding the required job change item first?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你還不該來這裡。
先去找齊轉職所需的物品吧？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are 3 buttons
on the escape switch.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF逃脫開關上有3個按鈕。^000000

scripts.text: Escape
scripts.translation: 逃脫

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Re-test
scripts.translation: 重新測試

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Escape Warp Portal
has now been activated.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF逃脫傳送門已啟動。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFCanceling
Operation.^000000

^3355FFYou will soon be
returned to the
waiting room.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你即將被送回候場室。^000000
